proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants Contact Other Plane as always prepared. The v4 atom grant_spell_access exists but ClassFeatureEffect only includes GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect — no grant_spell_access variant exists there.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you always have the Contact Other Plane spell prepared

proposed_widenings.name: grant_free_spell_cast (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: The once-per-long-rest activation grants a slot-free cast of a named spell. No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant can express 'cast a specific spell without expending a spell slot'. This is a new effect shape: a named-spell free-cast triggered by the feature's use_count.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cast the spell without expending a spell slot to contact your patron

proposed_widenings.name: grant_save_auto_succeed (modifier on named-spell cast)
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants automatic success on Contact Other Plane's INT saving throw when cast via this feature. The closest v4 atom is modify_roll_substitute, but no surface shape exists for 'auto-succeed' on a specific spell's cast-time save within a ClassFeatureEffect context.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you automatically succeed on the spell's saving throw

notes: All three required effect shapes are absent from ClassFeatureEffect. The family (activation) and kind (class_feature) exist and fit. The gaps are variants of existing surface types and v4 atoms (grant_spell_access is in v4), not structural gaps. The feature has two logically distinct sub-effects: (1) a permanent always-prepared grant and (2) a once-per-long-rest free cast with auto-succeed. The current ClassFeatureMechanics supports only a single effect per activation, so even if the effect variants were added, a multi-effect model may also require a surface widening.
